title.narrative: Voluntary medical program for orthopedics, physical therapy, and prosthetics

description.narrative: 1- Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment. 2- Performing specialized surgeries and installing artificial limbs. 3- Providing patients with medication needs as needed. 4- Alleviating the suffering of many patients who need surgical intervention. 5- Health education for everyone receiving treatment for prevention. 6- Assisting the Ministry of Health in the host country that suffers from a shortage of medical staff.
48 surgical operations were performed and the number of beneficiaries was 300
Providing medical services to beneficiaries with limited income who cannot cover the costs of their treatment in the fields of orthopedic surgery, physical therapy, and prosthetic limb fitting.
